result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue related to low-contrast text in the promotional banner.

issues.description: The text '3 free deliveries for you' and its supporting subtext in the light green promotional banner has insufficient color contrast against the background, making it difficult to read for visually impaired users and low-vision viewers.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text color to a darker shade (e.g., dark grey or forest green) that meets WCAG contrast standards against the light green background, ensuring clear, accessible readability.
